items.title: KINDNESS
items.quote: The kindness of G-d is all day long.
items.text: Hashem’s kindness is always accessible to protect the victims of persecution.

items.title: DECEITFUL TONGUE
items.quote: Your tongue plans treachery like a sharpened razor that acts deceitfully.
items.text: Evil talk is like a sharpened razor that cuts into the flesh when the user intended only to shave off the hair. You may fool yourself into thinking that evil talk is harmless, nothing more than words. But it can cut deep and is a great sin.

items.title: LOVING EVIL
items.quote: You love evil more than good, falsehood than speaking right.
items.text: Sinful behavior does not just happen. It begans with a sinful frame of mind which tolerates evil and is ultimately attracted to it.

items.quote: You love all devouring words, a tongue of deceit.

items.title: JUDGMENT
items.quote: Likewise, G-d will smash you for eternity. He will pluck you out and tear you away from the tent. He will uproot you from the land of life.
items.text: When Hashem’s wrath is invoked by evil behavior, He executes a harsh judgment.

items.title: FEAR OF SIN
items.quote: The tzadikim will see and fear.
items.text: No one is immune from sin. Even a tzadik should think about the lessons to be learned from the downfall of an evil man.

items.title: MOTIVE OF SIN
items.quote: Look the man who did not make G-d the source of his strength; but he trusted in his abundance of wealth.
items.text: A person who relies on his own wealth instead of the good will of Hashem, will be motivated to act unethically to achieve his objectives.

items.title: MOTIVE OF GOODNESS
items.quote: But I am like an ever-fresh olive tree in the House of G-d. I trust in the kindness of G-d forever and ever.
items.text: Plant your roots in the place where the Torah is studied, for that will inspire you to good deeds.

items.title: HOPE
items.quote: I will forever thank You for [what] You have done. I will hope in Your Name, for it is good.
items.text: Express your intention to continue to thank Hashem for all He has done. By showing your appreciation you will be deserving of hope in the future.
